purpose: Repair the failed B1 locator by replaying the upstream pixel lineage instead of relaxing its thresholds. Reconstruct the exact named 7x7 plate tile, rerun the pinned upstream SExtractor pass1 -> PSFEx -> pass2 chain, recover the frozen candidate by its original object_id/NUMBER, and measure morphology from that recovered pass2 centroid. External temporal/human/environmental labels remain sealed.

failure_diagnosis_frozen_before_B2.B1_transport: 64/64 sparse named-plate stamps succeeded without full-array access
failure_diagnosis_frozen_before_B2.B1_recovered: 5/64 under the preregistered SNR>=5 and <=12 px recenter rule
failure_diagnosis_frozen_before_B2.diagnosis: Final S0 RA/Dec is not a valid exact inverse locator into the raw full-plate GSSS image because S0 coordinates may carry tile TAN, per-plate CRPIX and later Gaia/WCS refinements. The upstream shape stage uses pass2 object_id/NUMBER -> pixel centroid instead.
failure_diagnosis_frozen_before_B2.forbidden_repair: Do not enlarge B1 search radius, lower B1 SNR, resample sources, or use external labels.

frozen_sample.selection: For each frozen structural cluster 0..15: two closest to cluster-median anomaly score plus two highest anomaly score, src_id tie-break.

upstream_replay_binding.tile_grid: tools/slice_plate_tiles.py: 7x7, 60 arcmin, grid centres in full-plate pixel space; tile_id from GSSS WCS centre rounded by vasco.utils.tile_id.format_tile_id
upstream_replay_binding.tile_WCS: Reproduce clean TAN refit from full-plate GSSS sampled on the exact tile footprint, then apply the frozen per-plate CRPIX correction from data/plate_crpix_table.csv.
upstream_replay_binding.pixel_centroid_rule: Exact pass2 NUMBER == frozen S0 object_id. Use XWIN_IMAGE/YWIN_IMAGE (or x_fit/y_fit only if upstream replay produces them). No nearest-neighbour replacement is admitted in B2.
upstream_replay_binding.shape_method: Run the pinned upstream scripts/stage_shape_post.py against regenerated tile FITS + pass2 catalog using its documented defaults.

public_sparse_transport.method: Astropy use_fsspec=True + PrimaryHDU.section for only the exact required 60-arcmin tiles; PrimaryHDU.data on the remote full plate is forbidden.
public_sparse_transport.expected_tile_scale: Approximately 2118x2118 pixels at ~1.7 arcsec/pixel; actual dimensions derive from each plate header exactly as upstream.

software_binding.note: B2 tests replay compatibility under this frozen public software environment. A numbering mismatch is a lineage failure, not silently repaired by positional matching.

forbidden: observation date as a feature or selection variable
selection_and_measurement_may_use: S0 RA/Dec only for a post-replay lineage-separation audit, never to choose a different pass2 row
raw plate pixels within the reconstructed tile
replayed pass2 catalogue and pixel centroids

predeclared_B2_gates.tile_identity_reconstruction: 64/64 sample rows must map to their frozen tile_id in the regenerated 7x7 grid; otherwise FAIL_CLOSED_TILE_IDENTITY.
predeclared_B2_gates.tile_sparse_transport: All distinct required tiles must be read as sparse sections without full remote plate arrays; otherwise FAIL_CLOSED_TRANSPORT.
predeclared_B2_gates.detection_chain: At least 95% of distinct required tiles must complete pass1 + PSFEx + pass2.
predeclared_B2_gates.exact_object_id_recovery: At least 90% of the 64 frozen sample rows must contain exact pass2 NUMBER == frozen object_id. No nearest-neighbour substitution.
predeclared_B2_gates.lineage_sky_consistency: Among exact-object recovered rows, at least 90% must have replay pass2 ALPHAWIN/DELTAWIN separation <=10 arcsec from frozen S0 RA/Dec; report median and p95 without retuning.
predeclared_B2_gates.pass2_raw_morphology: Among exact-object recovered rows, at least 95% must have finite FWHM_IMAGE, ELONGATION and SPREAD_MODEL.
predeclared_B2_gates.upstream_shape_execution: At least 90% of exact-object recovered rows must finish stage_shape_post without shape_failed; profile_diff/circularity missingness is reported separately and does not by itself rewrite lineage success.
predeclared_B2_gates.full_plate_array_access: Static source scan and runtime contract must forbid remote hdu.data/full plate materialization.

post_B2_rule: Only PASS_TILE_LINEAGE_REPLAY_AND_PIXEL_MORPHOLOGY_PILOT authorizes engineering a larger/full label-blind pixel-morphology sidecar. No B2 outcome authorizes nuclear/human/environment label reveal; that remains gated on a subsequently frozen full morphology manifest.
